name: picturereader
description: Local marketplace for the picturereader ZCode plugin: pixel-to-text image reading tools (image_scan / image_ocr / image_sample) plus the image-reading methodology skill, for text-only models. Fully local, no vision API.

plugins.name: picturereader
plugins.description: Gives text-only models the ability to 'read' images: downscale + color-quantize PNG/JPEG/GIF/BMP into a coarse pixel grid, OCR text locally, and sample exact pixels for material judgment. No vision model or API key required.
